title: Ivka's Pastry Snails
description: Delicious and easy party snack made with puff pastry filled with ham, bacon, and cheese.

instructions.name: Preparation
steps: Unroll and spread out the puff pastry.
Spread processed cheese over the puff pastry.
Spread ketchup, leaving about 2 cm from the edges.

instructions.name: Filling
steps: Layer ham in 3 rows, leaving 5 cm from the edges. Slices can overlap slightly.
Add bacon slices and corn (if using).

instructions.name: Shaping and baking
steps: Roll into 1 large roll and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes. The longer it chills, the easier it will be to cut.
Cut into 1.5-2 cm wide slices. If corn falls out, just push it back in.
Sprinkle more mozzarella on top so the whole slice is covered.
Bake at 180°C. When the mozzarella starts to turn yellow/brown, remove from oven (approximately 10-15 minutes).
